title: Similarity mode-knob cleanup: redundant strip-only delete, off-mode comment, embed tie-order
description:
Three low-severity follow-ups from the sutra/327 review (vidhi-review), all in src/similarity/mod.rs + src/db/similarity.rs:

1. strip-only re-runs a full-table `DELETE FROM hrr_vectors WHERE mode='embed'` on every incremental parse. First parse clears them; every later parse scans to delete 0 rows. Gate the delete so it only runs when embed vectors actually exist (or otherwise avoid the per-parse full scan).

2. mode=off returns (0,false) before recording hrr_file_hashes, so files_needing_hrr_recompute keeps reporting the same files and every parse re-derives off. This is arguably correct (flipping back to full then triggers a real recompute), but it reads like a bug — add a comment stating it's intentional.

3. embed similarity search (load_all_vectors_by_mode) is unordered, so exact-cosine ties can wobble run-to-run. The strip path was made deterministic (ORDER BY symbol_id); do the same for the embed load for consistency. Cosmetic — family membership is unaffected.</description>
<parameter name="acceptance_criteria">["strip-only mode does not issue a full-table embed delete when no embed vectors exist", "mode=off early-return has a comment explaining why hrr_file_hashes are intentionally not recorded", "load_all_vectors_by_mode returns rows ORDER BY symbol_id", "cargo test similarity passes"]
execution_record: Fix for #1 went deeper than a simple guard: the PK (symbol_id, mode) can't serve a mode-only predicate, so the embed purge, the strip family load, AND the embed similarity scan were all full-table scans of ~1KB/row blobs. Added a composite index idx_hrr_vectors_mode(mode, symbol_id) — one migration that fixes #1 and makes #3's ORDER BY free instead of a sort. Index is on the ephemeral hrr_vectors table, so the migration is ephemeral_only=true (reindex drops ephemeral tables and replays only ephemeral_only migrations; verified 0030_hrr_vectors is also true, so 0065 replays after it). Also gated the purge on a new has_embed_vectors() probe to skip the implicit write transaction in steady-state strip-only parses. Verified: cargo build clean; similarity_test 16/16, db-test 66/66, components_test 28/28 (the latter two exercise reindex/ephemeral-replay of the new index). Clippy: only pre-existing warnings in untouched files.
